name: Outlaw Tools v0.6.4
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.6.4

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.6.4

## Optional Windows Own-PC Sync

- Sign in with Discord in Settings and approve your installations on the Orbital Outlaws website. Only account/device and expiring connection metadata is stored there, never player records or raw game logs.
- Sync supported player records directly over an encrypted connection. Both PCs must be online and directly reachable. There is no cloud player-data backup or relay; blocked connections leave changes pending.
- First linking requires a reviewed source choice and backup. Inventory is not automatically added together. Conflicts remain available for review, with per-peer confirmed/pending progress and pause/sign-out controls.
- Retries and refinery collection receipts are deduplicated. Raw log observations stay private. Manual player-data export/import remains available offline. Linux remains manual-transfer only.

## Reliability And Limits

- Fixed review routing for single-lot conflicts affecting atomic stock groups. Bounded batches reduce memory/SQL pressure during sync backlogs, OCR and log catch-up.
- Includes pinned Windows transport libraries, upstream notices/sources and FFmpeg rebuild/replacement instructions. Physical two-PC/network coverage is limited: review your first sync and retain backups.

## Downloads

- Windows: `OutlawTools-Setup-0.6.4.exe` and SHA-256 checksum.
- Linux: `OutlawTools-linux-x86_64-0.6.4.tar.gz` and SHA-256 checksum.
